source_records.summary_text: Official 2026-09-01 release: agentic loop over video timelines (transcript/frame/audio on demand, adaptive FPS/resolution, prompt-driven); up to 88% fewer tokens (long-form) / 66% lower cost (benchmarks) / ~7% higher quality (vendor ceilings); 3.7/3.6/3.5-Lite launch, 3.8 in docs by 09-16; TTFT caveat <5 min; thinking/tool token accounting; NOT streaming.
